description.en:
Hides, or lets the match show again, the on-screen indicator for one team's goal ("forbit" is the developers' spelling of forbid).
Every frame the match hides the two indicators, one per team. It shows a team's indicator again while that team's goalkeeper is in the forced-win list (CMND_BTL_SET_FORCE_WIN), unless this flag is set for the team. This is the same update that keeps CMND_BTL_GET_NOT_FORCE_FAUL_FLAG in sync.
So with the scripts' usual forced wins on both goalkeepers, calling this for both teams keeps the indicators off. CMND_BTL_RESET_FORBIT_GOAL_VIEW clears the flags of both teams.
The team is not range-checked: pass 0 or 1.
Team whose indicator is concerned: 0 = the player's team, 1 = the opponent team.
true to hide the indicator, false to allow it again.

examples.case: Forced wins on both goalkeepers without the indicators (real usage, from btl0304.nut)
